tasks.title: Persist latest work-item attempts
tasks.description: Add the work-item attempt model for stage tasks and checks, including running, completed, failed, and interrupted states. Persist attempt history or equivalent snapshot data, synthesize latest attempts for existing task/check state, and expose aggregate methods for starting, completing, failing, interrupting, and reading the latest attempt.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks and checks can store a latest attempt with state, attempt number, timestamps, diagnostic output, and runtime evidence identifiers when available

Existing completed or passed work projects to a completed latest attempt, failed or error work projects to a failed latest attempt, running work projects to a running latest attempt, and pending work has no latest attempt until execution starts
Domain transitions update task/check progress and latest attempt state together so they cannot drift within one save operation
Attempt history or synthesized latest-attempt data remains available after repository reload
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use the smallest compatible persistence shape. A separate attempt table is preferred by the design, but an embedded snapshot is acceptable if it preserves latest-attempt semantics and reload behavior.

tasks.title: Record attempts during execution and stop paths
tasks.description: Wire stage task/check execution so each dispatched work item starts an attempt and records completed, failed, or interrupted results through the aggregate. Intentional agent stop and cancelled/lost session paths must mark the related attempt interrupted instead of failed unless the work handler produced an actual failure result.
acceptanceCriteria: Build task execution starts a running attempt before work is dispatched and records completed or failed when the task result is known
Check execution starts a running attempt before work is dispatched and records completed or failed when the check result is known
Intentional agent stop marks the associated running coder session and latest work-item attempt interrupted with a diagnostic reason
Thrown execution errors that represent genuine failed task/check results still produce failed attempts rather than interrupted attempts
Historical stop, interruption, and failure evidence remains visible in logs, sessions, or attempt diagnostics
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not convert interrupted work into failed work for retry convenience. Retry must remain reserved for genuine failed results.

tasks.title: Reconcile stale running attempts
tasks.description: Add a reconciliation service boundary that validates the current work item's running latest attempt against live execution evidence. Before recovery-sensitive reads or workflow resume decisions, stale running attempts with no active queue task and no live session/process evidence become interrupted and the workflow summary moves to waiting for recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: A running latest attempt with active queue or live agent/session evidence remains running and exposes wait or stop guidance
A running latest attempt with no running or pending queue task and no live related session/process evidence is changed to interrupted idempotently
Interrupted reconciliation records an interruption reason such as agent-stopped or agent-lost without marking the attempt failed
Workflow summary projection cannot report active running when the current work item's latest attempt is interrupted, failed, completed, or absent
Issue detail, stage-state, queue recovery, and workflow resume read paths invoke reconciliation before exposing primary recovery actions
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep runtime evidence as an internal port or helper, not a persisted first-class domain entity. Evidence checks should be bounded and local.

tasks.title: Gate API recovery verbs by latest attempt
tasks.description: Update retry, resume, rerun, issue detail, stage-state, and queue-related API behavior to use the reconciled recovery projection. Retry must target only a failed latest work-item attempt, while interrupted work returns a conflict or guidance for resume, rerun stage, or inspect.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/issues/:number/retry succeeds only when the reconciled latest work-item attempt is failed
Retry for an interrupted latest attempt returns a 409-style response with interrupted-specific guidance instead of treating it as failed work
Retry for a stale running attempt first reconciles the attempt and then returns the action allowed by the reconciled state
Rerun stage creates fresh attempts for work items in the current stage rather than retrying an interrupted attempt as failed
Issue detail and stage-state API responses include or expose a shared recovery projection that identifies the current work item, latest attempt state, workflow summary state, and allowed actions
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Preserve existing failed-task/check retry reset behavior, but choose retry eligibility from the latest failed work-item attempt instead of WorkflowRun.status alone.

tasks.title: Align CLI and Issue Detail recovery actions
tasks.description: Update the web UI and CLI status/show/recovery surfaces to render actions from the backend recovery projection. The issue detail page must stop enabling Retry solely from blocked issue status and must present interrupted work as resume, rerun, or inspect guidance instead.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue Detail does not render or enable Retry only because issue.status is blocked
Issue Detail enables Retry when and only when the reconciled latest attempt state is failed
Issue Detail presents interrupted latest attempts with resume, rerun stage, or inspect guidance and preserves blocked reason diagnostics as supporting evidence
CLI status/show/recovery output reports the same latest attempt state and allowed recovery actions as the API for running, completed, failed, and interrupted states
UI, CLI, and API agree on recovery action availability for the same issue fixture
Frontend and backend typechecks pass
tasks.notes: Keep the current page design. This task is about action correctness and shared recovery state, not a full issue detail redesign.

tasks.title: Add recovery-state regression coverage
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-run/spec.md; specs/workflow-engine/spec.md; specs/http-api/spec.md; specs/web-ui/spec.md; specs/cli-interface/spec.md; specs/ralph-task-execution/spec.md
tasks.description: Add focused regression tests for the stale-running contradiction from issue #229 and for a genuine failed work-item retry path. The coverage should prove reconciliation, recovery action selection, API conflicts, and UI or CLI action rendering remain consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: A regression fixture with blocked issue, running WorkflowRun, no running or pending queue task, stale running coder session, and pending materialized build task reconciles the latest attempt to interrupted
The #229-shaped fixture exposes no valid Retry action through API, UI, or CLI after reconciliation
The retry endpoint rejects the #229-shaped fixture with interrupted or stale-running recovery guidance rather than 'No failed workflow run to retry'
A genuine failed task attempt exposes Retry and successfully retries failed work using existing reset/downstream behavior
A genuine failed check attempt exposes Retry and successfully retries failed work using existing reset/downstream behavior or the existing check retry path
Relevant backend and frontend tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep fixtures narrow and explicit so the stale-running contradiction cannot regress silently.
